from_quote: The 5th section of the 1st article read
rationale: The journal records the reading of "The 5th section of the 1st article".

from_quote: the House of Representatives shall consist of members chosen for two years
rationale: Iredell says the Constitution "says, expressly" that the House members are chosen for two years.

from_quote: the Senate shall be composed of senators chosen for six years
rationale: Iredell says the Constitution "says, expressly" that the senators are chosen for six years.

from_quote: The migration or importation of such persons as any of the states now existing shall think proper to admit, shall not be prohibited by the Congress prior to the year 1808; but a tax or duty may be imposed on such importation, not exceeding ten dollars for each person
rationale: Iredell says the clause "runs in the following words" and quotes it (with "1808" for the clause's "one thousand eight hundred and eight").
to_quote: The Migration or Importation of such Persons as any of the States now existing shall think proper to admit, shall not be prohibited by the Congress prior to the Year one thousand eight hundred and eight, but a Tax or duty may be imposed on such Importation, not exceeding ten dollars for each Person

rationale: The journal records the reading of "Article 2d, section 1st".

from_quote: Congress to determine the time of choosing the electors, and to determine the time of electing the President
rationale: Taylor objects to Congress determining the time of choosing the electors and of electing the President, the power the clause on electors gives.
to_quote: The Congress may determine the Time of chusing the Electors
